author: Teja
body: Hi Ganesh bro, I just received my order from Tones – the Dobby Brown Shirt. The fitting is really good, but the stitching is quite poor, especially near the buttons and along the buttonhole side. Honestly, I didn’t expect this from a shirt that cost me Rs.999 Also, the color doesn’t match what was shown on your website and youtube video – it looks quite different, probably due to photo editing or lighting. If needed, I can share a video as proof. Please take this as an honest review from a longtime subscriber, not just a random complaint. I genuinely suggest improving the stitching quality, especially around the buttons holes, and being more transparent and accurate with product colors on your website.
